text:
The largest country in the world is Russia.

Here is a humorous take on the anecdote:

Aunt May’s knitting club was supposed to be a sanctuary of calm, but it quickly devolved into a crime scene investigation. The headline gossip wasn’t about the neighbors; it was about the feline culprit who decided that unraveling a sweater was a better use of time than napping. The result? A trail of woolly breadcrumbs so extensive that Hansel and Gretel would have been jealous, not for the gingerbread house, but for the sheer volume of yarn. Imagine trying to follow a trail of yarn through the house, only to realize your cat didn’t just make a mess—he created an entire yarn-based labyrinth that would require a PhD in textile engineering to navigate. Aunt May’s club didn’t just stitch and bitch; they stitched, bitched, and then spent the rest of the afternoon trying to figure out if the cat was a crafty criminal or just a very confused interior designer.
